description: Get the full tariff detail for ONE HTS code, AND resolve its Section 301 (China) / Section 232 (steel & aluminum) Chapter-99 add-on duties into an effective-total view. Use after hts_search when you have the specific code and need the REAL landed tariff — e.g. "8712.00.48 is 11% base, plus Section 301 9903.88.03 +25% on China-origin = 36% effective". Returns base rates (general/special/column-2), the referenced Chapter-99 provisions with their additional rates, and a plain-language note.

hts_code.description: A specific HTS code, e.g. "8712.00.48" or "8712.00.48.00"

name: hts_lookup
